title: Dataset chart: visualise the second dimension as grouped series (multi-dim charts)
body:
## Problem

Dataset-bound chart rendering (introduced in #1757 / objectstack-ai/framework#1890) only honours the **first** dimension. When a chart's dataset selects two dimensions (e.g. `dimensions: ['status', 'priority']`), `queryDataset` correctly returns the full `status × priority` grouping, but the renderer maps `xAxisKey = dimensions[0]` and `series = values`, so:

- the X axis repeats the first-dimension label once per second-dimension bucket (e.g. `Backlog`, `Backlog`, `Done`, `Done`, …), and
- the **second dimension is not visualised at all** — no per-`priority` colour/group/legend.

The data is all there; the second dimension is just invisible. This is a pre-existing limitation of the dashboard `DatasetWidget` that the chart-view renderer (`ObjectChart`) inherited.

## Proposed fix

When `dimensions.length >= 2` (and a single measure), pivot the long-format result into wide-format and derive one **series per second-dimension value**:

- `xAxisKey = dimensions[0]`
- `series = distinct values of dimensions[1]` (one coloured/grouped bar series each)
- cell value = `values[0]`

Apply consistently in **both** `ObjectChart` (`plugin-charts`) and `DatasetWidget` (`plugin-dashboard`) — ideally via a shared `buildChartSeries(rows, dimensions, values, fields)` helper so numbers/labels stay identical across surfaces.

Edge cases to define: 2 dims + N measures (ambiguous — fall back to measures-as-series on dim0), >2 dims (use first two), missing second-dim buckets (zero-fill).

## Verification

showcase Task → "Hours by Status (Chart)" (`dimensions: ['status','priority']`) should render grouped/coloured bars by priority with a priority legend.

Refs objectstack-ai/framework#1890, #1757
